founders.name: Mark Rooney
founders.bio: A former professional footballer turned music events specialist. Mark was diagnosed with Stage 4 kidney cancer in 2018. He has channelled his experience of music's healing power in cancer wards into Cancer Staged.

founders.name: Steve Bond
founders.bio: A serial entrepreneur with a career spanning retail, sports and the music industry. Survived a sudden cardiac arrest; now helps build how the UK fights cancer.

founders.name: Joe Rider
founders.bio: An operational leader with 30 years across agency, tech culture and live events. Joe makes Cancer Staged work - turning vision into action, and ambition into impact.

trustees.name: Mark Rooney
trustees.bio: A former professional footballer turned music events specialist. Mark was diagnosed with Stage 4 kidney cancer in 2018. He has channelled his experience of music’s healing power in cancer wards into Cancer Staged.

trustees.name: Steve Bond
trustees.bio: A serial entrepreneur with a career spanning retail, sports and the music industry. Steve survived a sudden cardiac arrest, saved by his wife’s quick-thinking CPR. That second chance brought him to Cancer Staged.

trustees.name: Professor Jonathan Lim
trustees.bio: Jonathan is a consultant medical oncologist at The Christie NHS Foundation Trust in Manchester, one of Europe’s largest specialist cancer centres, bringing frontline clinical experience to the board.

advisors.name: Professor Samra Turajlic
advisors.bio: Samra is a consultant medical oncologist and cancer researcher with the Cancer Research UK Manchester Institute. Her work on how cancers evolve, particularly kidney cancer and melanoma, is internationally recognised.
